description: This file defines generic and specific implementations of a producer grain for Orleans streams, including functionality to produce items to streams, manage timers, and handle producer exceptions. It also includes definitions for specific fruit-related classes and interfaces.

classes.name: TypedProducerGrain<T>
classes.description: A generic Orleans grain that produces messages to an Orleans stream of type T, supporting periodic production, start/stop controls, and exception handling.

classes.name: TypedProducerGrainProducingInt
classes.description: A specialized grain extending TypedProducerGrain for integer items, overriding production logic to send the number directly.

classes.name: TypedProducerGrainProducingApple
classes.description: A specialized grain extending TypedProducerGrain for Apple objects, overriding production to produce new Apple instances.

classes.name: Apple
classes.description: A serializable class representing an apple with a unique number, implementing IFruit.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Initializes the grain upon activation, resetting produced items count.

methods.name: BecomeProducer
methods.description: Configures the grain to produce to a specified stream identified by GUID and namespace.

methods.name: StartPeriodicProducing
methods.description: Starts a timer to produce items periodically at a specified or default interval.

methods.name: StopPeriodicProducing
methods.description: Stops the periodic production timer and throws if there are accumulated exceptions.

methods.name: GetNumberProduced
methods.description: Returns the current count of produced items.

methods.name: ClearNumberProduced
methods.description: Resets the produced items count to zero.

methods.name: Produce
methods.description: Triggers production of a single item.

methods.name: TimerCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked by the timer to produce an item.

methods.name: ProducerOnNextAsync
methods.description: Produces an item to the stream asynchronously, with error handling.

methods.name: Fire
methods.description: Main produce method called periodically or manually; increments counter and produces an item.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the grain deactivates.
